name: HorizontalPortals
description: Allows creation of horizontal portals (floors and ceilings).

name: CommandsOnUse
description: Executes console or player commands when a portal is used.

name: Permissions
description: Restricts portal usage using permission nodes.

options.name: permissionDenyMessage
options.default: You do not have permission to use this portal.

name: LimitedUses
description: Limits how many times a portal can be used before deactivating.

name: ChargeOnUse
description: Charges currency via Vault when players use a portal.

options.name: chargeDenyMessage
options.default: You cannot afford to use this portal!

name: CustomLighter
description: Allows custom items to ignite portals and customize frame/inside blocks.

name: Daylight
description: Restricts portal usage based on daylight level or time of day.

options.name: dayLightDenyMessage
options.default: This portal only operates during certain hours of the day.

name: HubWorld
description: Routes players through a central hub world location.

name: IgniteByEvent
description: Ignites portals automatically when triggered by environmental events.

name: MessageOnUse
description: Sends customizable chat messages when entering a portal.

name: ModelEngine
description: Attaches 3D ModelEngine models to active portals.

name: Particles
description: Adds custom particle effects and animations around portals.

name: PastedPortals
description: Pastes WorldEdit schematics when portals are built or activated.

name: PortalSounds
description: Plays ambient sound effects when players interact with portals.

name: ProxyAddon
description: Enables cross-server portal teleports via BungeeCord or Velocity networks.

name: RandomLocation
description: Teleports players to a safe random location within a configured radius.

name: StylishPortals
description: Allows non-rectangular custom portal geometry.

name: TimedPortals
description: Automatically destroys or deactivates portals after a timer expires.

name: Unbreakable
description: Prevents portal structures from being broken by players or explosions.

name: Weather
description: Controls portal availability based on weather conditions (rain, thunder, clear).

options.name: weatherDenyMessage
options.default: This portal cannot be activated during this weather!

name: Biomes
description: Restricts portal creation or usage to specified biomes.

name: BetterPortals
description: Hooks into BetterPortals for seamless portal rendering.

name: ForceLink
description: Forces specific portal link pairings between locations.

name: WorldGuardFlags
description: Integrates with WorldGuard region flags for portal access control.

name: PatreonCosmetics
description: Exclusive portal cosmetics and particle trails for Patreon supporters.

name: PortablePortals
description: Allows players to spawn portable temporary portals using commands.

name: PortalTp
description: Allows players to teleport to the nearest portal of a given type.

name: CustomWorlds
description: Integrates custom world generators for portal destination worlds.

name: DimensionsBungee
description: BungeeCord proxy component for multi-server networking.

name: DimensionsVelocity
description: Velocity proxy component for multi-server networking.

name: ExampleAddon
description: Reference template for building custom Dimensions addons.
